KIMODO_PANEL_SEGMENTS: Parts for Kimodo to make (between keys; the parts you leave off stay as they are)
KIMODO_PANEL_NO_SEGMENTS: Add at least two keys to the clip.
KIMODO_PANEL_SERVER_STARTING: Preload: getting ready (this takes a few minutes)
KIMODO_PANEL_SERVER_STOPPED: Preload: off (each motion takes about 4 minutes to start)
KIMODO_PANEL_SERVER_MEMORY: While preloading, about 15 GB of the PC's memory stays in use. Stop it when you are done.
KIMODO_PANEL_HINT_PYTHON: (about 2 minutes for a new description, about 30 seconds for the same one)
KIMODO_PANEL_RESULT_SHOWING: Showing the new motion. Keys you add now go into the layer on top and are not used the next time Kimodo makes a motion.
KIMODO_PANEL_RESULT_EDITING: Editing the keys. The new motion is hidden while you do.
KIMODO_PANEL_DEVIATIONS: How far Kimodo's motion was from each key (before it was matched to the keys)
KIMODO_PANEL_DEVIATION_LARGE: {0}  - large (try adding keys or changing the description)
KIMODO_CONSOLE_EMPTY: When you make a motion, what Kimodo did shows here. Make one from the Kimodo panel of the Motion Editor window.
KIMODO_RUN_ALREADY_RUNNING: Kimodo is already making a motion. Wait until it finishes, or stop it.
KIMODO_RUN_NO_SEGMENTS: Choose the parts for Kimodo to make.
KIMODO_RUN_SERVER_STARTING: Preloading is still getting ready. Wait until it is ready, or stop it.
KIMODO_RUN_TOO_FEW_KEYS: Add at least two keys to the clip. Kimodo makes the motion between the keys.
KIMODO_RUN_TOO_LONG: The clip is longer than 10 seconds. Kimodo can make up to 10 seconds.
KIMODO_RUN_NO_SCRIPTS: Some files of the Kimodo sample are missing. Import the sample again from the Package Manager.
KIMODO_RUN_NO_DRIVER: A file of the Kimodo sample (kimodo_run.py) is missing. Import the sample again from the Package Manager.
KIMODO_RUN_PYTHON_FAILED: Kimodo could not be started ({0}). Check the Python location in the settings.
KIMODO_RUN_DOCKER_FAILED: Docker could not be started ({0}). Check that Docker Desktop is running.
KIMODO_RUN_NO_CLIP: Open a clip in the Motion Editor window.
KIMODO_RUN_UNKNOWN_MODE: "Match the Keys" has a value it does not know: {0}
KIMODO_RUN_NO_SKELETON: Kimodo's skeleton is not set. Press "Check That It Works" in the Kimodo Install window.
KIMODO_RUN_NO_TOKEN: You are not signed in to Hugging Face (there is no token file in {0}). Do steps 1 and 2 in the Kimodo Install window.
KIMODO_RUN_NO_PYTHON: Choose the python.exe where Kimodo is installed ("Python" in Project Settings > Lilium Motion Editor > Kimodo).
KIMODO_RUN_NOT_INSTALLED: Kimodo is not installed for {0}. Do step 2 in the Kimodo Install window.
KIMODO_RUN_PYTHON_BROKEN: The Python in the settings could not be run. Check that its location is right.
KIMODO_RUN_NO_FOLDER: Choose the folder where you put Kimodo.
KIMODO_RUN_NO_DOCKER: Docker Desktop is not running. Start it and try again.
KIMODO_RUN_NO_IMAGE: Kimodo ({0}) has not been built in Docker yet. See "Advanced" in the Kimodo Install window.
KIMODO_RUN_OPEN_TO_IMPORT: Done. Open {0} in the Motion Editor window and press Import.
KIMODO_RUN_KEYS_CHANGED_DIALOG: The keys of {0} changed after they were sent to Kimodo. Import the new motion anyway?
KIMODO_RUN_KEYS_CHANGED: Done, but the keys changed after they were sent. Import it as it is, or make it again.
KIMODO_RUN_IMPORTED_BETWEEN: The new motion now fills {0} part(s) between keys ({1}).
KIMODO_RUN_HINT_GPU: Docker cannot use the NVIDIA graphics card (GPU). Update the graphics card driver and check Docker Desktop's settings.
KIMODO_RUN_HINT_GPU_MEMORY: The graphics card ran out of memory. Close other programs that use it (games and so on) and try again.
KIMODO_RUN_HINT_HUGGING_FACE: Hugging Face did not let Kimodo download the model. Check that your request for Llama 3 was approved, and run hf auth login again.
KIMODO_RUN_HINT_WSL_MEMORY: The PC ran out of memory for Docker. Give Docker more memory: write [wsl2] memory=24GB in %USERPROFILE%\.wslconfig.
KIMODO_RUN_QUIT_DIALOG: Kimodo is still making a motion. Stop it and quit Unity?
KIMODO_SERVER_QUIT_DIALOG: Kimodo's preloading is running and is using about 15 GB of the PC's memory. Stop it?
KIMODO_SKELETON_OPEN_BVH: The T-pose BVH file made with Kimodo
KIMODO_SKELETON_SAVE_MESSAGE: Where to save the skeleton file
KIMODO_SETUP_INTRO: Three steps make Kimodo ready. You need an NVIDIA graphics card and about 16 GB of free memory.
KIMODO_SETUP_APPLY_ACCOUNT: Make an account and apply to use Llama 3 (free)
KIMODO_SETUP_APPLY_TOKEN: Make a "Read" token (a kind of password) and copy it
KIMODO_SETUP_INSTALL_TEXT: Press the button and choose where to put Kimodo. It takes 30 minutes to an hour. When it asks for the token, paste it and press Enter.
KIMODO_SETUP_CHECK_TEXT: Press this when the black window says Done.
KIMODO_SETUP_READY_NOTE: Ready. Make motions from the Kimodo panel of the Motion Editor window.
KIMODO_SETUP_NO_TPOSE: The file for Kimodo's skeleton (tpose.bvh) is not there yet. Press "Install Everything..." again and let it finish.
KIMODO_SETUP_READY_INTRO: Kimodo is ready to use. Come back here when you want to install it again or change how it is set up.
KIMODO_SETUP_INSTALL_WINDOWS_ONLY: "Install Everything" works on Windows only. On other systems, follow the README.
KIMODO_SETUP_INSTALL_CONFIRM:
Kimodo will be installed into {0}.

A window opens and installs what is needed, one step at a time. It downloads about 25 GB in all and can take 30 minutes to an hour. If git, uv or the C++ compiler is missing, it asks before installing them.
KIMODO_SETUP_INSTALL_RUNNING: Installing in the other window. Follow what it says; when it says Done, press "Check That It Works".
KIMODO_SETUP_INSTALL_NO_SCRIPT: A file of the Kimodo sample (install_kimodo.ps1) is missing. Import the sample again from the Package Manager.
KIMODO_SETUP_INSTALL_FAILED: The install window could not be opened: {0}
KIMODO_SETUP_DOCKER: Docker: run the build commands to build Kimodo inside Docker (about 35 GB) with Docker Desktop running, then choose the Kimodo folder below.
KIMODO_SETUP_SKELETON: Kimodo's skeleton: "Check That It Works" makes it from tpose.bvh in the Kimodo folder. To make it yourself, run the T-pose command and choose the file with "Make From BVH...".
KIMODO_SETUP_COPIED: Kimodo: copied the commands. Paste them into a command prompt and run them.
KIMODO_SETTINGS_SAVED_IN: These settings are for this PC only (saved in UserSettings/LiliumKimodoSettings.asset and not shared with others).
KIMODO_SETTINGS_PYTHON_TOOLTIP: The python.exe made when you installed Kimodo (for example kimodo/.venv/Scripts/python.exe)
KIMODO_SETTINGS_KIMODO_FOLDER_TOOLTIP: The folder where you downloaded Kimodo (git clone)
KIMODO_SETTINGS_HUGGING_FACE_CACHE_TOOLT: The folder where Hugging Face keeps its files (the token and the models). When empty: {0}
KIMODO_SETTINGS_NOTE: The steps and the license terms are in the sample's README. Kimodo reads your Hugging Face token (password) by itself; this page never reads it.
KIMODO_PANEL_NOT_READY: Kimodo is not ready to use yet. Open the install guide and go through its steps.
